title: Reel: where a creator video loses its days
hook: Where a creator video loses its days between brief and live.
caption:
Where a creator video loses its days between brief and live.

The shoot gets blamed. Late feedback is the costlier part, because a rewrite is quick and a reshoot is slow.

Three checkpoints that move feedback to the front:
1. Approve the script on paper before any camera rolls.
2. Name one person who gives the feedback, in one round.
3. Judge the first cut against the brief, never against taste.

Feedback becomes a yes or a no, and the video goes live. Follow @galvor.ai.

The reel shows a timeline from brief to live with feedback moving from the end to the start, and three checkpoints: approve on paper, one voice and one round, and judge against the brief. End card: follow @galvor.ai.

script.setup: Idea: a brand manager who thinks creator videos are slow and unpredictable sees that the delay sits in late feedback, and gets three checkpoints that move it to the front. On-screen title: Where creator videos lose days. Expectation set: a diagnosis. The script gives it in the second scene and beats it with three checkpoints to copy. Outline: late feedback costs most (the turn); approve on paper (second-best, first); one voice, one round; judge against the brief (best).
